Name: Rare Dwumrohl

Description.name: Rare Dwumrohl
Description.description: Expanding their tastes beyond music, Rare Dwumrohls are avid practitioners of the visual arts as well. With so many digits at their disposal, it's unsurprising to learn that their favorite medium is finger-painting! Adorning their drum sets with luminescent paint, they've even swapped out drumsticks for special tensible paintbrushes!

Combinations to Breed: Zap The Eggs Needed To Fill Rare Dwumrohl
